title: She laid pennies on his eyes
html_source:
A reference to Charon’s obol. Coins placed on or around the mouth before burial to guarantee the transfer of the soul to the land of the dead.

This is usually associated with the Greeks and the Romans. It is also commonly—but mistakenly—said that the coins were placed on the eyes.
